name: markxp/iap-auth-shield
description: IAP authentication and REST API firewall controlled by system environment variables, protecting the backend while keeping the frontend open.

scripts.test: bash -c 'if [ -x vendor/bin/phpunit ]; then vendor/bin/phpunit "$@"; else ../../vendor/bin/phpunit "$@"; fi' --
scripts.test:container: bash -c 'if [ -x vendor/bin/phpunit ]; then docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/plugin:z" -w /plugin mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php vendor/bin/phpunit "$@" || docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/plugin" -w /plugin mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php vendor/bin/phpunit "$@"; else ROOT="$(cd ../.. && pwd)" && REL="${PWD#${ROOT}/}" && (docker run --rm -v "${ROOT}:/workspace:z" -w "/workspace/${REL}" mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php /workspace/vendor/bin/phpunit "$@" || docker run --rm -v "${ROOT}:/workspace" -w "/workspace/${REL}" mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php /workspace/vendor/bin/phpunit "$@"); fi' --

scripts.lint:fix: bash -c 'if [ -x vendor/bin/pint ]; then vendor/bin/pint "$@"; else ../../vendor/bin/pint "$@"; fi' --
scripts.lint:fix:container: bash -c 'if [ -x vendor/bin/pint ]; then docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/plugin:z" -w /plugin mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php vendor/bin/pint "$@" || docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/plugin" -w /plugin mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php vendor/bin/pint "$@"; else ROOT="$(cd ../.. && pwd)" && REL="${PWD#${ROOT}/}" && (docker run --rm -v "${ROOT}:/workspace:z" -w "/workspace/${REL}" mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php /workspace/vendor/bin/pint "$@" || docker run --rm -v "${ROOT}:/workspace" -w "/workspace/${REL}" mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php /workspace/vendor/bin/pint "$@"); fi' --
scripts.test:sapi:container: bash -c 'ROOT="$(cd ../.. && pwd)" && REL="${PWD#${ROOT}/}" && (docker run --rm -v "${ROOT}:/workspace:z" -w "/workspace/${REL}" mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-fpm-alpine sh -c "apk add --no-cache nginx bash >/dev/null && bash bin/test-sapi.sh $1" || docker run --rm -v "${ROOT}:/workspace" -w "/workspace/${REL}" mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-fpm-alpine sh -c "apk add --no-cache nginx bash >/dev/null && bash bin/test-sapi.sh $1")' --
